expenditures.detail: 43 Schedule B rows over three sheets sum to 57,282.21 against the printed 57,222.21 - a delta of +60.00, the ROWS EXCEEDING the filer's own figures. The page-subtotal gate TRACES it to ONE sheet: p9's 17 rows sum to 37,350.09 = printed subtotal 37,350.09 EXACT; p10's 17 rows sum to 14,718.35 against its printed subtotal 14,658.35, SHORT BY 60.00 in the filer's addition; p11's 9 rows sum to 5,213.77 = printed subtotal 5,213.77 EXACT. The filer's three printed subtotals add to his printed grand total exactly (37,350.09 + 14,658.35 + 5,213.77 = 57,222.21), so the discrepancy sits between his p10 rows and his p10 addition. NOTHING WAS NUDGED: the whole p10 amount column was read as an 800 dpi strip and every cell that could absorb a round 60.00 was escalated to a tight 2000 dpi crop - row 14 (1,060.00, where 1,000.00 would have closed the page and the glyph is unambiguously a 6), row 7 (280.00, where 220.00 would have closed it and the glyph is unambiguously an 8) and rows 8 and 9 (70.00 each, where 10.00 would have closed it) - and every one reproduced its full-page reading. No cell can absorb it, the ADDENDUM G6 standard. Trap F1.5 was ruled out on p10 by the one-past-the-end crop, which rendered the printed subtotal and nothing else. The correlated-error screen is inconclusive by absence: this is the only Phelps filing in the chunk, and his other five sheets close exactly.

in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND on the contributions side - both conventions tested on both sides, as ADDENDUM G1 requires. This filer segregates in-kind onto its OWN Schedule A sheet, hand-headed 'In Kind Donations' (p7, 10 rows, 10,596.37); monetary-only would give 62,235.00 and FAILS Column A by exactly that, while monetary-plus-in-kind gives 72,831.37 and closes to the cent against Column A and the schedule's printed grand total. So the in-kind gifts ARE inside his stated cash-column figure. The in-kind gifts are NOT double-entered as offsetting expenditures (the Voeks pattern of G1 does not occur here) - Schedule B marks no row in-kind, so both conventions are identical there and neither closes the +60.00 delta.

notes: Jim Phelps, page-face office 'Utah County Sheriff', party 'Republican'; index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the PAGE FACE governs and the coordinator may promote the name through office_overrides.csv (the Ainge precedent). 11 pages, legacy_colAB: p1 cover ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election', signed 6-18-2018, clerk stamp JUN 18 PM 3:20), p2 SUMMARY PAGE, pp3-8 SCHEDULE A ('Page 1..6 of 6'), pp9-11 SCHEDULE B ('Page 1..3 of 3'). *** CORRECTION TO THE CHUNK BRIEF: THIS FILING IS NOT ON 2016-HEADED STOCK. *** The wave brief lists Phelps alongside Sakievich as a filing 'already known to carry 2016-headed sheets'. That is right for Sakievich and WRONG for Phelps: every one of this filing's ten inner sheets is strap-lined '2018 County & Local School Candidates', and the cover is the county-only blank 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5) with the sidebar 'County & Local School Candidates'. Read alongside Grunander and Leavitt in this same chunk, genuinely 2018-dated stock is now established beyond doubt - ADDENDUM G5 left that open. The brief's related warning that this filing's OCR sidecar shows '-16'-looking dates that are really '-18' is consistent with what the page shows: the filer writes his year as '-18' throughout, and every entry is a 2018 date. *** THE COVER CARRIES ONLY TWO FIGURES. *** Column B (Year-to-Date) is blank on both lines and the whole Balance Summary (lines 3-7) is left EMPTY - not zeros and not dashes, simply unfilled - so this filing has no ladder at all and ADDENDUM A3's blank-cover recovery is unavailable. Both sides were gated on Column A plus each schedule's own printed subtotals and grand total; nothing was synthesized. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS ALSO WHOLLY UNANSWERED - neither 'Yes' nor 'No' is ticked, an honest BLANK, never 'No' (ADDENDUM A4). *** THE FILER SEGREGATES BY KIND ONTO SEPARATE SHEETS. *** Schedule A p5 is hand-headed 'In Kind Donations' (10 rows) and p6 'LOANS to Campaign' (4 rows, all the candidate's own money). Both sheets' subtotals are inside his printed Total Contributions Received, so both publish as contribution rows - the loans by the ADDENDUM B3 ladder (line 3 is blank, so no beginning-balance slot exists and the schedule falls 29,500.00 short without them). This is a cleaner instance of the same question than Kirk 2010 or Grierson 2012 because the filer labels the sheet himself. SCHEDULE B COLUMN VOCABULARY: 'Provider/Vendor', with NO Purpose column. This filer usually writes only the payee; on nine rows he appends a purpose after a hyphen or as a trailing word ('Proponet Ink - shirts', 'The Daily Herald ad'), which is the ADDENDUM E5 workaround, and `purpose` carries that trailing phrase while `vendor_raw` carries the payee. Where he wrote none, purpose is honestly blank. THREE 'Anonymous' CONTRIBUTION ROWS (5.00, 10.00, 10.00) name no donor and give no address. They are published as the document reports them - never split, never attributed - and their city/state are blank because the filer entered none, which is a distinct reason from the five in ADDENDUM E4. PRIVACY: the county did NOT redact this filing; full street lines are visible on every Schedule A sheet and on both Schedule B sheets, and the cover prints the candidate's own home address and phone number. None of it is carried: contributions reduce to city/state at read time, expenditure rows carry no address field at all, and no street line, box number, phone or fax reaches any field or note. INTRA-DOCUMENT DATE VARIANCE: the Date of Report box reads '6-18-2018' on pp3 and 8, '6-18-18' on pp5,6,7,9,10,11 and simply '2018' on p4. All recorded, none adjudicated. The 2018 Utah County SHERIFF filing fee is 618.19 (p9 row 9). Recorded as an observation for the wave's fee table only - ADDENDUM E1/F5 forbid using it to settle a figure elsewhere.
